description: Saved channel collections. No input: every collection of the organizations you belong to, plus the ones you starred. Pass ids (up to 25) to read specific collections, or source to list only one kind. Each row carries channel_ids in the collection's order — pass them to get_channels for profiles and metrics. An empty channel_ids means the collection is empty; don't call get_channels for it.

ids.description: Collection ids to read; yours or any public one. Omit to list your own

source.description: 'organization': only your organizations' collections; 'starred': only the ones you starred. Omit for both

name: get_collections

channel_ids.description: In the collection's order; pass to get_channels

organization.description: Organization that owns the collection; null when you are not a member

url.description: statiko.io page of a public collection; null when private

unresolved.description: Requested ids no collection you can view answered to

title: Your collections
